instruction.shortdesc: Compute Reciprocal of Scalar FP16 Value

para.string: This instruction performs a SIMD computation of the approximate reciprocal of the low FP16 value in the second source operand (the third operand) and stores the result in the low word element of the destination operand (the first operand) according to the writemask k1. Bits 127:16 of the XMM register destination are copied from corre­sponding bits in the first source operand (the second operand). The maximum relative error for this approximation is less than 2

Bits 127:16 of the destination operand are copied from the corresponding bits of the first source operand. Bits MAXVL-1:128 of the destination operand are zeroed. The low FP16 element of the destination is updated according to the writemask.
